data.name: Maddening Style
data.description: When you clobber an opponent with your fists, you inundate its mind with visions of madness and horror. You gain one additional use of Stunning Fist per day. When using this style, if you have at least 1 point in your ki pool, you increase the DCs of your confusion, madness, and insanity effects (including Maddening Strike) by 1.
